rationale: Register the pre-existing P2.6 bypass-inventory subsystem during Blocker #202 repository-memory reconciliation. The governed implementation already exists; this change binds stable semantic ownership without adding runtime feature behavior.
authority_impact: Adds repository-memory classification only. The inventory can classify bypass reachability/disposition for certified pilots but cannot authorize recommendations, alter routing, execute legacy paths, or convert ungoverned code into certified behavior.
